question: What makes attention 'self-attention' specifically?
options: Queries, keys, and values are all derived from the same input sequence
It only attends to a single token

question: What is the time complexity of standard self-attention with respect to sequence length n?
options: O(n²) — every position attends to every other position
O(log n) — logarithmic via tree structure

question: How does causal (masked) self-attention differ from bidirectional self-attention?
options: Causal masks future positions so each token only attends to itself and earlier tokens, enabling autoregressive generation
Causal attention is faster but less accurate
Causal attention drops the value vectors
Causal attention runs the softmax twice
